reviews.comment: has a lot on her plate and no time for her students. critiques from her are not helpful and unclear and she shows up to class late many times. communication is lacking and students never know what's expected, she makes a lot of last minute changes and cannot manage time properly which puts us to a disadvantage. no time for office hours either

She is unorganized and unclear causing confusing when it comes to due dates and expectations. We often run out of time in class forcing her to rush through the last people, giving them little feedback.

shows up to class 30 minutes late. if youre toward the end of the line for desk crit forget about feedback she wont get to you. she doesnt know any of the assignments herself she asks the students to explain them after we read them. she tells everyone in the class a different due date. Ive never met someone so unorganized. Please do not take her.

Unorganized and hardly has time for her students. shows up to class late and you have to stay behind to get any critique from her. we never knew what was expected of us. She is ok as professor, workload was not hard.
